//: Keyword groups: every group must match, any keyword in a group. Matching lowercases text and keywords and folds runs of space, '-' and '_' into one space, so 'cleanup_policy_dry_run', 'cleanup policy dry run' and 'cleanup-policy dry-run' are the same; the variants below are listed for the reader. G1 was checked against the library (no Pub/Sub expiration content) when chosen; G1 used to be the IAM binding item, which knowledge/patterns/gcp-iam-conventions.md already holds.

items.title: Pub/Sub subscriptions expire after 31 days of inactivity by default; expiration_policy { ttl = "" } makes them never expire
Uniform bucket-level access can be disabled only within 90 days (lockedTime), then it is permanent
Cloud SQL: deletion_protection is Terraform-only; settings.deletion_protection_enabled blocks console/API deletion
Artifact Registry cleanup policies: preview with cleanup_policy_dry_run = true before enforcing

duplicate.title: Stale GCS state lock: confirm no run, terraform force-unlock (already in the KB)

//defects: Planted defects the Step 5a reviewers should FLAG. A FLAG line (FLAG <candidate-id> <type>: <reason>) is a true positive when its type matches a defect and its candidate id + reason match that defect's regex; a leak/secret/duplicate FLAG matching no defect is a false positive. accuracy/confidence flags have no planted defect: reported as unplanted, not scored.
